ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT AGREEMENT dated as of une_Q7_, 2014, between HP Yuco Housing Development Fund Company, Inc., a New York housing corporation, and BX Properties, LLC, a New York limited liability company both having an .office at c/o Yuco Management, Inc., 200 Park Avenue, 11th Floor, New York, New York 10166 ("Developer"), and Consolidated Edison Company of New York, Inc., a New York corporation having an office at 4 Irving Place, New York, New York 10003 ("Owner"). WITNESSETH WHEREAS, Owner is the owner of the fee title to a certain parcel of land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, in Bronx County, City and State of New York, known as and by (i) the street address of 447-453 East 147th Street (also known as 453 East 147th Street), and (i) the Tax Lot Number 56, Block 2292 (said land and tax lot being hereinafter referred to as “Lot A" or “Owner's Land", and more particularly described on Exhibit “A” attached hereto and made a part hereof; said buildings and being hereinafter referred to as the "Owner's Building"; and said land and buildings and improvements being hereinafter collectively referred to as the "Owner's Premises"); WHEREAS, Developer is the owner of the fee title to a certain parcel of land, in Bronx County, City and State of New York, known as and by (i) the street address of 463 East 147th Street, and (ii) the Tax Lot Number 50, Block 2292 (said land and tax lot being hereinafter referred to as “Lot B" or “Developer's Land", and more particularly described on Exhibit “B" attached hereto and made a part hereof; and said land and any buildings and other improvements hereafter built on Developer's Land being hereinafter collectively referred to as the "Developer's Premises"); WHEREAS, Developer may acquire development rights with respect to, or fee simple title to, additional parcels (the “Additional Parcels") such that Owner's Land, Developer's Land, and the Additional Parcels are contiguous and, pursuant to the Declaration hereinafter referred to, constitute a single “zoning lot” under Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined);
